API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APISecurity Policy SettingsManage Blacklist
Manage Blacklist
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/security/advanced

Updates the list of URLs that are on the denylist. This overwrites a previously-generated denylist. If you need to completely erase the denylist, submit an empty list.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Updates the Advanced Threat Protection policy's denylist.

blacklistUrls
string[]

URLs on the denylist for your organization. Allow up to 25000 URLs.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
blacklistUrls
string[]

URLs on the denylist for your organization. Allow up to 25000 URLs.
